To get the current weather in Berlin, you can check a reliable weather service like [Weather.com](https://weather.com), [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com), or [OpenWeatherMap](https://openweathermap.org). Alternatively, you can use a voice assistant (e.g., Siri, Google Assistant) or search "Berlin weather" in your browser for real-time updates.

Since I don’t have live data access, I recommend using one of these sources for the most accurate and up-to-date information. Would you like help interpreting weather terms or planning based on the forecast?
